description: This file provides utility functions for date and time manipulation using dayjs, including formatting, timezone support, DST detection, and conversions between strings and dayjs objects.

methods.name: yyyymmdd
methods.description: Converts a Date or Dayjs object to a string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

methods.name: daysInMonth
methods.description: Returns the number of days in the month of the given date.

methods.name: formatTime
methods.description: Formats a date/time into 12-hour or 24-hour string, optionally with timezone.

methods.name: isSupportedTimeZone
methods.description: Checks if a timezone string is recognized as valid by dayjs.

methods.name: formatLocalizedDateTime
methods.description: Formats a date or Dayjs object into a localized string based on options and locale.

methods.name: formatToLocalizedDate
methods.description: Formats a date into a localized date string.

methods.name: formatToLocalizedTime
methods.description: Formats a date into a localized time string.

methods.name: formatToLocalizedTimezone
methods.description: Returns the localized timezone name.

methods.name: sortByTimezone
methods.description: Sorts two timezones by their GMT offset.

methods.name: isPreviousDayInTimezone
methods.description: Checks if a given time is the previous day in another timezone.

methods.name: isNextDayInTimezone
methods.description: Checks if a given time is the next day in another timezone.

methods.name: weekdayToWeekIndex
methods.description: Converts weekday string or number to a numeric index (0-6).

methods.name: getTimeZone
methods.description: Retrieves the timezone name from a Dayjs object.

methods.name: timeZoneWithDST
methods.description: Determines if a timezone observes Daylight Saving Time.

methods.name: getDSTDifference
methods.description: Calculates the difference in minutes between DST and standard time for a timezone.

methods.name: getUTCOffsetInDST
methods.description: Gets the UTC offset during DST for a timezone.

methods.name: isInDST
methods.description: Checks if a Dayjs date is currently in DST based on its timezone.

methods.name: getUTCOffsetByTimezone
methods.description: Gets the UTC offset for a timezone at a specific date.

methods.name: stringToDayjs
methods.description: Converts a string with timezone info into a Dayjs object with correct offset.

methods.name: stringToDayjsZod
methods.description: Zod schema for transforming string into Dayjs object with timezone.
